rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: With fatḥa on the wāw, waqūd means firewood or fuel.
rows.anchor: أي حطبها. والوقود: الحطب؛ بفتح الواو.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: With ḍamma on the wāw, wuqūd means the act of burning or kindling.
rows.anchor: الوقود: الحطب؛ بفتح الواو. والوقود بضمها: توقدها.

rows.speaker: المفسرون
rows.claim: The commentators identify the stones as stones of sulfur.
rows.anchor: والحجارة} قال المفسرون: حجارة الكبريت.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being dead before life refers to sperm in the wombs.
rows.anchor: يعني نطفا في الأرحام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Anything that leaves the body, including hair, a nail, or sperm, is considered dead.
rows.anchor: وكل شيء فارق الجسد من شعر أو ظفر أو نطفة فهو ميتة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God gives life to you in the wombs and in worldly life.
rows.anchor: فأحياكم} في الأرحام وفي الدنيا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first death is sperm becoming dead upon entering the womb; it is brought to life there and in this world, then dies and is raised at resurrection.
rows.anchor: فالميتة الأولى: إخراج النطفة وهي حية من الرجل، فإذا صارت في الرحم فهي ميتة؛

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Istawā ilā means that God turned or directed Himself toward the heaven.
rows.anchor: ثم استوى إلى السماء} عمد لها.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In Arabic usage, one who leaves a task and turns to another has istawā lahu or istawā ilayhi, whether the first task was finished or not.
rows.anchor: وكل من كان يعمل عملا فتركه بفراغ أو غير فراغ وعمد لغيره، فقد استوى له واستوى إليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pronoun in fasawwāhunna refers to the seven heavens.
rows.anchor: وقوله: {فسواهن} ذهب إلى السماوات السبع.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The introductory idh is extra; the sense is simply, “Your Lord said to the angels,” with its omission explained in al-Mushkil.
rows.anchor: أراد: وقال ربك للملائكة، و"إذ" تزاد والمعنى إلقاؤها

rows.speaker: أهل النظر من أصحاب اللغة
rows.claim: Linguists infer that God had told the angels the successor's descendants would corrupt and shed blood; the angels' question presupposes this information, and the account is abbreviated.
rows.anchor: يرى أهل النظر من أصحاب اللغة: أن الله جل وعز قال: إني جاعل في الأرض خليفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jahratan means openly and visibly, not in sleep or any other state.
rows.anchor: أي علانية ظاهرا، لا في نوم ولا في غيره.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The thunderbolt here means death, as the next verse says they were raised after their death.
rows.anchor: أي الموت. يدلك على ذلك قوله: {ثم بعثناكم من بعد موتكم}

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The reading nunsihā means “or cause you to forget it,” with the omitted object understood as you.
rows.anchor: أراد: أو ننسكها. من النسيان.

rows.speaker: قارئ بالهمز
rows.claim: A hamzated reading, nunsāʾhā, means to defer the verse rather than abrogate it until a later term; sale on credit and postponing Muḥarram's sanctity illustrate the sense of delay.
rows.anchor: ومن قرأها: "أو ننسأها". بالهمز (1) . أراد: نؤخرها فلا ننسخها إلى مدة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Better” means more excellent; its advantage lies in being easier and lighter.
rows.anchor: نأت بخير منها} أي: بأفضل منها. ومعنى فضلها: سهولتها وخفتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Khayr here means property or wealth.
rows.anchor: إن ترك خيرا} أي مالا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The bequest is to be made for parents and relatives in a fair amount, without extravagance or harm.
rows.anchor: أي يوصي لهم ويقتصد في ذلك، لا يسرف ولا يضر.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This bequest rule was abrogated by the inheritance rules.
rows.anchor: لا يسرف ولا يضر. وهذه منسوخة بالمواريث.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A sick person or traveler must make up a number of days equal to those missed.
rows.anchor: أي فعليه عدة من أيام أخر مثل عدة ما فاته.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earlier provision allowing a ransom meal for one poor person was abrogated by the command to fast when present for the month.
rows.anchor: وهذا منسوخ بقوله: {فمن شهد منكم الشهر فليصمه} (2) .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-shahr is accusative as a temporal adverb, not as an object of shahida; the sense is whoever is present during the month and is not traveling should fast.
rows.anchor: والشهر منصوب لأنه ظرف. ولم ينصب بإيقاع شهد عليه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being present during the month can describe either a resident or a traveler, which is why shahida is not construed as taking the month as its object.
rows.anchor: لأن الشهادة للشهر قد تكون للحاضر والمسافر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In pre-Islamic custom, pilgrims recalled their forefathers' finest deeds after completing the pilgrimage, such as hospitality and kinship ties.
rows.anchor: كانوا في الجاهلية إذا فرغوا من حجهم ذكروا آباءهم بأحسن أفعالهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God commands remembrance equal to or greater than their remembrance of their fathers, since He did these good things for them and their fathers.
rows.anchor: فأنا فعلت ذلك بكم وبهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-maysir means gambling; Ibn Qutayba refers readers to his discussion of its benefit in al-Māʾida.
rows.anchor: والميسر} القمار. وقد ذكرناه في سورة المائدة، وذكرنا النفع به.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question asks what they should give in charity.
rows.anchor: ويسألونك ماذا ينفقون} أي: ماذا يتصدقون ويعطون؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-ʿafw is the surplus beyond one's own and dependents' sustenance; it can also mean what comes easily, without compulsion or hardship.
rows.anchor: قل العفو} يعني: فضل المال. يريد: أن يعطي ما فضل عن قوته وقوت عياله.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to accept what people freely volunteer means not to press them for more than they offer.
rows.anchor: ومنه قوله عز وجل: {خذ العفو وأمر بالعرف} (1) ؛ أي: اقبل من الناس عفوهم، وما تطوعوا به من أموالهم؛ ولا تستقص عليهم.

words: حَآجَّ إِبْرَٰهِۦمَ فِى رَبِّهِۦٓ أَنْ ءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُلْكَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ruler disputed with Abraham because God had given him kingship; he became impressed with himself and his power.
rows.anchor: أي: حاجه لأن آتاه الله الملك؛ فأعجب بنفسه وملكه فقال: {أنا أحيي وأميت}

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His claim to give life means pardoning someone liable to execution; to give death means killing whomever he chooses.
rows.anchor: أي: أعفو عمن استحق القتل فأحييه؛ و "أميت": أقتل من أريد قتله فيموت.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Buhita means that the disbeliever's argument was cut off.
rows.anchor: فبهت الذي كفر} أي: انقطعت حجته.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The near neighbor is the neighbor who is a relative.
rows.anchor: والجار ذي القربى} القرابة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-janb means distant; the neighbor described this way is a stranger.
rows.anchor: والجار الجنب} الغريب (5) والجنابة: البعد.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The companion by one's side is a travel companion.
rows.anchor: والصاحب بالجنب} الرفيق في السفر (1) .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The son of the road refers to a guest.
rows.anchor:
وابن السبيل} الضيف.
و (المختال) ذو الخيلاء والكبر.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mukhtāl is a person characterized by pride and conceit.
rows.anchor: و (المختال) ذو الخيلاء والكبر.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They wish to become dust and merge with the earth into one thing.
rows.anchor: أي يكونون ترابا، فيستوون معها حتى يصيروا وهي شيئا واحدا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They will not conceal anything from God when, after denying their deeds, their limbs testify against them.
rows.anchor: هذا حين سئلوا فأنكروا فشهدت عليهم الجوارح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prohibition concerns entering mosques while in major impurity, except to pass through without staying or settling there.
rows.anchor: يعني المساجد لا تقربوها وأنتم جنب إلا مجتازين غير مقيمين ولا مطمئنين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-ghāʾiṭ means excretion; originally it meant low-lying ground where people went to relieve themselves, and thus became a euphemism.
rows.anchor: الغائط} الحدث. وأصل الغائط: المطمئن من الأرض.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tayammamū means to intend or direct yourselves toward something.
rows.anchor:
فتيمموا} أي تعمدوا.
{صعيدا طيبا} أي ترابا نظيفا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ṣaʿīd ṭayyib means clean soil.
rows.anchor: صعيدا طيبا} أي ترابا نظيفا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-maysir is gambling; yassartu means casting lots with arrows, and the person who does so is called yāsir, yāsirūn, yusr, or aysār.
rows.anchor: والميسر} القمار. يقال: يسرت: إذا ضربت بالقداح والضارب بها يقال له: ياسر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In harsh winter, wealthy and generous people slaughtered and divided a camel by arrows; the winner gave the shares to the needy, the benefit mentioned in 2:219.
rows.anchor: وكان أصحاب الثروة والأجواد في الشتاء عند شدة الزمان وكلبه ينحرون جزورا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People praised winning the arrow draw, disparaged those who declined it as abram, and called one such person a baram.
rows.anchor: وكانوا يتمادحون بأخذ القداح ويتسابون بتركها ويعيبون من لا ييسرون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The anṣāb were stones worshiped in pre-Islamic times.
rows.anchor: والأنصاب} حجارة كانوا يعبدونها في الجاهلية.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-azlām are divining arrows, discussed earlier in this sūra.
rows.anchor: والأزلام} القداح. وقد ذكرتها في أول هذه السورة (5) .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The root meaning of rijs is stench.
rows.anchor:
والأزلام} القداح. وقد ذكرتها في أول هذه السورة (5) .
{رجس} وأصل الرجس: النتن.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Kh waḍ in God's signs means speaking of them mockingly.
rows.anchor: {يخوضون في آياتنا} بالاستهزاء.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qinwān means palm clusters and is the plural of qinw; the plural keeps the pattern's nūn vowels, unlike the dual, as in ṣinw and ṣinwān.
rows.anchor: (القنوان) عذوق النخل. واحدها قنو. جمع على لفظ تثنيته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fruit at the time it first appears is tender and unripe.
rows.anchor: انظروا إلى ثمره إذا أثمر} وهو غض.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Yanʿ means the fruit's ripening and maturity; the verb can be yāniʿat or aynʿat, and the noun has several forms.
rows.anchor: وينعه} أي إدراكه ونضجه. يقال: ينعت الثمرة وأيعنت: إذا أدركت.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The dead person in the comparison was an unbeliever whom God guided; the light is faith, and walking by it means being guided, while darkness represents unbelief.
rows.anchor: أومن كان ميتا فأحييناه} أي: كان كافرا فهديناه. {وجعلنا له نورا} إيمانا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The jinn's having much of humankind means they led many people astray.
rows.anchor: يا معشر الجن قد استكثرتم من الإنس} أي: أضللتم كثيرا منهم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each side took a share or benefit from the other.
rows.anchor: وقال أولياؤهم من الإنس ربنا استمتع بعضنا ببعض} أي: أخذ كل من كل نصيبا (1) .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their appointed term is death.
rows.anchor: وبلغنا أجلنا} أي الموت.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prohibited animals include every bird with talons and every animal with an unsplit hoof.
rows.anchor: حرمنا كل ذي ظفر} أي كل ذي مخلب من الطير وكل ذي ظلف ليس بمشقوق.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fat carried on the animals' backs refers to the fat tail, al-aliyya.
rows.anchor: شحومهما إلا ما حملت ظهورهما} يقال: الألية.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-ḥawāyā are the entrails; their singular forms are ḥāwiya and ḥuwiya.
rows.anchor: أو الحوايا} المباعر؛ واحدها حاوية وحوية (1) .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Khalf means inferior people or speech; an expression such as “this is khalf of speech” uses it for something bad.
rows.anchor: فخلف من بعدهم خلف} والخلف: الرديء من الناس ومن الكلام،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God intervenes between a believer and sin, and between an unbeliever and obedience.
rows.anchor: بين المؤمن والمعصية وبين الكافر والطاعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another explanation is that God comes between a person and his desire.
rows.anchor: ويكون: يحول بين الرجل وهواه (2) .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-ʿudwa is the edge or bank of a valley; the word is also pronounced with a different vowel.
rows.anchor: العدوة} شفير الوادي. يقال: عدوة الوادي وعدوته.

words: مَا دَامَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The exception and duration in this clause are explained in his book al-Mushkil; no further gloss is given here.
rows.anchor: خالدين فيها ما دامت السماوات والأرض إلا ما شاء ربك} مبين في كتاب "المشكل" (1) .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ghayr majdhūdh means uncut or unsevered; jadadta, jadhadta, jadhafta, and jadafta are all said for cutting.
rows.anchor: غير مجذوذ} أي: غير مقطوع. يقال: جذذت، وجددت وجذفت، وجدفت؛ إذا قطعت.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Falawlā here means “why did there not” or “if only.”
rows.anchor: فلولا كان من القرون من قبلكم} أي: فهلا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People of baqiyya are people with a remnant of religion, moral firmness, and goodness.
rows.anchor: أولو بقية} أي: أولو بقية من دين. يقال: [قوم] لهم بقية وفيهم بقية.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wrongdoers followed the wealth they had been given, preferring it and being tempted by it.
rows.anchor: واتبع الذين ظلموا ما أترفوا فيه} ما أعطوا من الأموال؛ أي: آثروه واتبعوه ففتنوا به (1) .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sārib means someone going about his affairs during the day.
rows.anchor: وسارب بالنهار} أي: متصرف في حوائجه. يقال: سرب يسرب.

rows.speaker: الشاعر
rows.claim: An unnamed poet uses sārib for one who has gone away; the line supports the word's sense of going.
rows.anchor:
وقال الشاعر:
أرى كل قوم قاربوا قيد فحلهم ... ونحن خلعنا قيده فهو سارب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The plea means “keep me and them away,” with “them” understood for the children.
rows.anchor: واجنبني وبني} أي: اجنبني وإياهم (2) .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The idols caused many people to go astray, or many went astray through them.
rows.anchor: رب إنهن أضللن كثيرا من الناس} أي: ضل بهن كثير من الناس.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-sirr is what a person keeps secret and does not disclose.
rows.anchor: يعلم السر} ما أسررته ولم تظهره.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Akhfā refers to what a person has only told himself.
rows.anchor: وأخفى} ما حدثت به نفسك.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prayer is established so that the worshipper remembers God within it.
rows.anchor: وأقم الصلاة لذكري} أي لتذكرني فيها.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ahushshu bihā means striking leaves down with the staff.
rows.anchor: وأهش بها على غنمي} أخبط بها الورق.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Maʾārib means other needs or purposes; its singular is maʾriba or maʾraba.
rows.anchor: ولي فيها مآرب أخرى} أي حوائج أخرى. واحدها: مأربة ومأربة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God will restore the transformed object to being a staff as it was before.
rows.anchor: سنعيدها سيرتها الأولى} أي: نردها عصا كما كانت.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Taniyā means do not weaken or slacken; its verbal forms include waniya yanī and wani yunā.
rows.anchor: ولا تنيا} أي لا تضعفا ولا تفترا. يقال: ونى في الأمر يني.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Yusḥitukum means to destroy or eradicate; the verb is also said as saḥata or asḥata.
rows.anchor: فيسحتكم بعذاب} أي يهلككم ويستأصلكم. يقال: سحته الله وأسحته.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one who fabricates has lied.
rows.anchor: وقد خاب من افترى} أي كذب.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase means to gather or marshal your stratagems.
rows.anchor: فأجمعوا كيدكم} (1) أي حيلكم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ṣaffan can mean coming together as a group.
rows.anchor: ثم ائتوا صفا} أي جميعا. وقال أبو عبيدة: الصف: المصلى.

rows.speaker: أبو عبيدة
rows.claim: Abū ʿUbayda says al-ṣaff means a place of prayer.
rows.anchor: وقال أبو عبيدة: الصف: المصلى. وحكى عن بعضهم أنه قال

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: A speaker used “I could not come to the ṣaff today” to mean that he could not come to the prayer place.
rows.anchor: وحكى عن بعضهم أنه قال: ما استطعت أن آتي الصف اليوم، أي المصلى (2) .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The tyrant's command or authority takes effect only in this worldly life.
rows.anchor: إنما تقضي هذه الحياة الدنيا} أي إنما يجوز أمرك فيها.

words: وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُقْضَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُۥ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet is told not to recite before revelation to him is complete.
rows.anchor: لا تعجل بتلاوته قبل أن يفرغ من وحيه إليك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet used to hurry to recite before Gabriel finished, fearing he might forget.
rows.anchor: وكان رسول الله - صلى الله عليه وعلى آله – يبادر بقراءته قبل أن يتمم جبريل، خوفا من النسيان.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Adam's forgetting means that he abandoned the covenant.
rows.anchor: فنسي} أي ترك العهد (2) .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ʿAzm means a firmly resolved judgment or purpose.
rows.anchor: ولم نجد له عزما} أي رأيا معزوما عليه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase means that sunlight will not strike you.
rows.anchor: ولا تضحى} أي لا يصيبك الضحى، وهو الشمس (3) .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ḍank means constricted or narrow.
rows.anchor: معيشة ضنكا} أي ضيقة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sky is protected from devils by the stars.
rows.anchor: سقفا محفوظا} من الشياطين، بالنجوم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People turn away from the signs and lessons contained in the sky.
rows.anchor: وهم عن آياتها معرضون} أي عما فيها: من الأدلة والعبر.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-nūn means fish, so Dhā al-Nūn is the one associated with the fish.
rows.anchor: وذا النون} ذا الحوت. والنون: الحوت.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lan naqdira ʿalayhi means “to make things narrow for him,” as when someone's provision is restricted; the cited usage in 89:16 confirms this sense.
rows.anchor: فظن أن لن نقدر عليه} أي نضيق عليه. يقال: فلان مقدر عليه، ومقتر عليه في رزقه.

rows.speaker: غير مسمى
rows.claim: One interpretation identifies the inherited land as the land of Paradise.
rows.anchor: يقال: أرض الجنة، ويقال: الأرض المقدسة

rows.speaker: غير مسمى
rows.claim: Another interpretation identifies it as the Holy Land, inherited by the community of Muḥammad.
rows.anchor: ويقال: الأرض المقدسة، ترثها أمة محمد صلى الله عليه وعلى آله.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's sacred rites include casting the pebbles, standing at Jamʿ, and similar rites.
rows.anchor: ومن يعظم حرمات الله} يعني رمي الجمار، والوقوف بجمع، وأشباه ذلك. وهي شعائر الله.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prohibited livestock categories recited in al-Māʾida include carrion, animals killed by blows, falls, or goring.
rows.anchor: وأحلت لكم الأنعام إلا ما يتلى عليكم} يعني في سورة المائدة من الميتة والموقوذة والمتردية والنطيحة (3) .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Atrafna means that God gave them abundance until they became luxurious; turfa is linked with tuḥfa, as a pampered person is one given gifts.
rows.anchor: أترفناهم في الحياة الدنيا} وسعنا عليهم حتى أترفوا،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ghuthāʾ means they perished like the foam and debris carried atop a flood, which disperses and goes away.
rows.anchor: فجعلناهم غثاء} أي هلكى كالغثاء، وهو ما علا السيل من الزبد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Dhikruhum here means their honor or renown.
rows.anchor: بل أتيناهم بذكرهم} أي بشرفهم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Kharj means a payment or levy, which the people would find burdensome.
rows.anchor: أم تسألهم خرجا} أي خراجا، فهم يستثقلون ذلك.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Kharāj from God means His provision.
rows.anchor: فخراج ربك خير} أي رزقه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Zakā means to become pure.
rows.anchor: ما زكا منكم من أحد} أي ما طهر.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Yuzakkī means that God purifies.
rows.anchor: الله يزكي} أي يطهر.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On that Day hearts turn from their worldly states of doubt and disbelief, and eyes are opened as their coverings are removed.
rows.anchor: تتقلب عما كانت عليه في الدنيا: من الشك والكفر؛ وتتفتح فيه الأبصار من الأغطية.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The night is called clothing because it covers people.
rows.anchor: جعل لكم الليل لباسا} أي سترا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Subāt means rest; its original sense is stretching out.
rows.anchor: والنوم سباتا} أي راحة. وأصل السبات: التمدد.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nushūr means people spread out or go about during the day.
rows.anchor: وجعل النهار نشورا} أي ينتشرون فيه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-khabʾ is what is concealed in the heavens or earth, from khabaʾtu al-shayʾ, “I hid the thing.”
rows.anchor: الذي يخرج الخبء في السماوات والأرض} أي المستتر فيهما.

rows.speaker: غير مسمى
rows.claim: A common saying calls rain the hidden thing of heaven and vegetation the hidden thing of earth.
rows.anchor: خبء السماء: المطر. وخبء الأرض: النبات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The expression balagha ashuddahu was explained earlier.
rows.anchor: ولما بلغ أشده} قد تقدم ذكره (3) .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Istawā means that his youth became complete and settled, with no further increase.
rows.anchor: واستوى} أي استحكم وانتهى شبابه واستقر: فلم تكن فيه زيادة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tilqāʾ means toward or facing Midian; it derives from liqāʾ with an added tāʾ.
rows.anchor: تلقاء مدين} أي تجاه مدين ونحوها. وأصله:

rows.speaker: الشاعر
rows.claim: An unnamed poet uses tilqāʾ in the sense of meeting or facing someone, supporting its relation to liqāʾ.
rows.anchor: قال الشاعر: فاليوم قصر عن تلقائه الأمل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sawāʾ al-sabīl means the straight or intended course.
rows.anchor: سواء السبيل} أي قصده.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Umma here means a group of people.
rows.anchor: {وجد عليه أمة من الناس يسقون} أي جماعة (1) .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tadhūdān means the two women were keeping their sheep back; the object “sheep” is omitted for concision.
rows.anchor: {ووجد من دونهم امرأتين تذودان} أي تكفان غنمهما.

rows.speaker: أبو صالح
rows.claim: Abū Ṣāliḥ's commentary says one woman held the sheep back for the other.
rows.anchor: وفي تفسير أبي صالح: "تحبس إحداهما الغنم على الأخرى". (2)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mā khaṭbukumā means “what is your affair or situation?”
rows.anchor: قال ما خطبكما} أي ما أمركما؟ وما شأنكما؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The form yaṣduru al-riʿāʾ means the shepherds return from the water.
rows.anchor: (يصدر الرعاء) (3) أي يرجع الرعاء.

rows.speaker: قارئ غير مسمى
rows.claim: A reading with the shepherds as transitive agents means that they drive their sheep away from the water.
rows.anchor: ومن قرأ: {يصدر الرعاء} ؛ أراد: يرد الرعاء أغنامهم عن الماء.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Taʾjurnī means to compensate him for the marriage; divine ajr is likewise recompense for a deed.
rows.anchor: على أن تأجرني} أي تجازيني عن التزويج، والأجر من الله إنما هو: الجزاء على العمل.

words: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَٰبٍۢ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their scriptures establish that Muhammad was unlettered; had he written, those who deny would have doubted the revelation.
rows.anchor: هم يجدونك أميا في كتبهم فلو كنت تكتب لارتابوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-ḥayawān means the abode of life: Paradise, where there is no death.
rows.anchor: وإن الدار الآخرة لهي الحيوان} يعني: الجنة هي دار الحياة؛ أي لا موت فيها.

words: مِّن رِّبًۭا لِّيَرْبُوا۟ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِ ٱلنَّاسِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The riba offering is intended to increase one's holdings through other people's wealth.
rows.anchor: وما آتيتم من ربا ليربو في أموال الناس} أي ليزيدكم من أموال الناس.

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās explains this as someone giving a gift in hope of receiving a greater return; it does not grow with God.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عباس: "هو الرجل يهدي الشيء يريد أن يثاب أفضل منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Zakāt here means alms or charity.
rows.anchor: وما آتيتم من زكاة} أي من صدقة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-muḍʿifūn are those who receive multiplication and increase.
rows.anchor: تريدون وجه الله فأولئك هم المضعفون} أي الذين يجدون التضعيف والزيادة (3) .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-jarz is hard, dry land without vegetation; its plural is ajrāz, and drought years are called sunūn ajrāz.
rows.anchor: الأرض الجرز} الغليظة اليابسة التي لا نبت فيها (1) . وجمعها:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Awwibī means praise God; taʾwīb originally described traveling all day and stopping at night.
rows.anchor: يا جبال أوبي معه} أي سبحي (1) . وأصله: التأويب في السير؛ وهو: أن تسير النهار كله

rows.speaker: ابن مقبل
rows.claim: Ibn Muqbil's poem uses awb al-sayr for a journey continuing through the day, illustrating the root's travel sense.
rows.anchor:
قال ابن مقبل:
[لحقنا بحي] أوبوا السير بعد ما ... دفعنا شعاع الشمس والطرف يجنح (2)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sābighāt are broad or ample coats of mail.
rows.anchor: (السابغات) الدروع الواسعة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qaddir fī al-sard means to regulate the mail's weaving and rivets: rivets must not be so thin that rings loosen or so thick that they break.
rows.anchor: وقدر في السرد} أي في النسج، أي لا تجعل المسامير دقاقا فتقلق ولا غلاظا فتكسر الحلق.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A maker of mail rings is called sarad or zarad, with s and z alternating as in sirāṭ and zirāṭ.
rows.anchor: ومنه قيل لصانع [حلق] الدروع: سراد وزراد. تبدل من السين الزاي، كما يقال: سراط وزراط.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sard also means sewing or stitching; al-Shammākh's poem uses the word in this sense.
rows.anchor: والسرد: الخرز أيضا. قال الشماخ: كما تابعت سرد العنان الخوازر (1)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A hearthstone is also called a misrad or sarad.
rows.anchor: ويقال للإثفي: مسرد وسراد.

words: وَإِن تَدْعُ مُثْقَلَةٌ إِلَىٰ حِمْلِهَا لَا يُحْمَلْ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌۭ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A soul burdened with sins cannot get another to carry any of its burden, even if the person it calls is a close relative.
rows.anchor: وإن تدع مثقلة إلى حملها لا يحمل منه شيء} يقول: إن دعت نفس ذات ذنوب قد أثقلتها ذنوبها ليحمل عنها شيء منها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The living and the dead are a comparison for intelligent and ignorant people.
rows.anchor: وما يستوي الأحياء ولا الأموات} مثل للعقلاء والجهال.

words: جُدَدٌۭ بِيضٌ وَحُمْرٌ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Judud are stripes or paths in mountains, some white, some red, and some intensely black.
rows.anchor: ومن الجبال جدد بيض وحمر مختلف ألوانها وغرابيب سود}

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gharābīb is the plural of gharīb, meaning intensely black; one may say aswad gharīb.
rows.anchor: وغرابيب: جمع غربيب وهو: الشديد السواد. يقال: أسود غربيب.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The preceding mountain-color statement ends at kadhālika, meaning that mountains differ in color.
rows.anchor: وتمام الكلام عند قوله: {كذلك} يقول: من الجبال مختلف ألوانها.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The colors of people, animals, and livestock differ likewise, as do the colors of fruits.
rows.anchor: ومن الناس والدواب والأنعام مختلف ألوانه كذلك} أي كاختلاف الثمرات.

words: إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى ٱللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْعُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The clause about the scholars fearing God begins a new sentence.
rows.anchor: ثم يبتدئ: {إنما يخشى الله من عباده العلماء}

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What people send ahead is their deeds; their traces are the practices they establish for others to follow.
rows.anchor: ونكتب ما قدموا} من أعمالهم؛ {وآثارهم} ما استن به بعدهم من سننهم.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He compares the phrase to 75:13, which speaks of what a person sent ahead and left behind as a lasting trace.
rows.anchor: وهو مثل قوله: {ينبأ الإنسان يومئذ بما قدم وأخر} (1)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One explanation takes “alive” to mean a believer.
rows.anchor: لينذر من كان حيا} أي مؤمنا. ويقال: عاقلا.

rows.speaker: غير مسمى
rows.claim: Another reported explanation takes “alive” to mean rational or intelligent.
rows.anchor: أي مؤمنا. ويقال: عاقلا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sawāʾ al-jaḥīm means its middle.
rows.anchor: سواء الجحيم} وسطها (2) .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-fulk al-mashḥūn is a filled or loaded ship.
rows.anchor: إلى الفلك المشحون} أي السفينة المملوءة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sāhama means that they cast lots.
rows.anchor: فساهم} أي فقارع.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-mudḥaḍīn are those who lost the casting of lots; the root's original sense is slipping, and to invalidate an argument makes it slip away.
rows.anchor: فكان من المدحضين} أي من المقروعين. يقال: أدحض الله حجته فدحضت؛ أي أزالها

rows.speaker: ابن عيينة
rows.claim: Ibn ʿUyayna explains sāhama as gambling and al-mudḥaḍīn as those who lost the gamble.
rows.anchor: وقال ابن عيينة: {فساهم} أي قامر. {فكان من المدحضين} أي المقمورين"

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mulīm means sinful; a man is called alāma when he commits a sin for which he deserves blame.
rows.anchor: وهو مليم} أي مذنب. يقال: ألام الرجل (2) ؛ إذا أذنب ذنبا يلام عليه.

rows.speaker: غير مسمى
rows.claim: An alternative reported sense of al-musabbiḥīn is those who pray.
rows.anchor: فلولا أنه كان من المسبحين} يقال: من المصلين.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Salakahu means God put the water into the earth and made it springs that gush forth.
rows.anchor: فسلكه ينابيع في الأرض} أي أدخله [فيها] فجعله ينابيع: عيونا تنبع.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Yahīj means to dry up.
rows.anchor: ثم يهيج} أي ييبس.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ḥuṭām means broken fragments, like chaff or crumbled debris.
rows.anchor: ثم يجعله حطاما} مثل الرفات والفتات.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Dākhirīn means humbled or abased.
rows.anchor: داخرين} أي صاغرين.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muqrinīn means able or capable; ana muqrin laka means “I can manage you.”
rows.anchor: وما كنا له مقرنين} أي مطيقين. يقال: أنا مقرن لك؛ أي مطيق لك.

rows.speaker: غير مسمى
rows.claim: Another usage, “I am qarn to so-and-so,” means that one is his equal in strength.
rows.anchor: ويقال: هو من قولهم: أنا قرن لفلان؛ إذا كنت مثله في الشدة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: With qarn vocalized with fatḥa, the expression means “I am his equal in age.”
rows.anchor: وإن فتحت - فقلت: أنا قرن لفلان. - أردت: أنا مثله في السن (3) .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Umma means a single religion or way of belief.
rows.anchor: إنا وجدنا آباءنا على أمة} أي على دين واحد (2) .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Umma means a single religion or way of belief.
rows.anchor: إنا وجدنا آباءنا على أمة} أي على دين واحد (3) .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an is a source of honor and renown for the Prophet and his people.
rows.anchor: وإنه لذكر لك ولقومك} أي شرف لكم؛ يعني القرآن (6) .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They will be asked whether they showed gratitude for the Qur'an.
rows.anchor: وسوف تسألون} عن الشكر عليه.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mublisūn means despairing of God's mercy.
rows.anchor: وهم فيه مبلسون} أي يائسون من رحمة الله.
